title: Holographic Representation of One-Dimensional Many-Body Quantum States via Isometric Tensor Networks
abstract_summary: Introduces holographic isoTNS (isometric tensor network states): 1D lattice of isometric tensors with a physical horizontal axis and auxiliary holographic axis. Achieves volume-law entanglement at modest bond dimension, surpassing MPS. Can faithfully represent fermionic Gaussian states, Clifford states, and short-time-evolved states.
relevance_reason: Holographic axis in 1D isometric tensor network is structurally analogous to our MERA extra dimension. Volume-law capability at low bond dimension is relevant to chi=3 MERA expressivity.
connection_to_project: The holographic isoTNS is a cousin of our MERA — both use an extra dimension for holographic encoding. The volume-law result suggests our chi=3 MERA may have additional expressivity headroom beyond current tests.
